<?php
class Base86A {
    public function capture() {
        echo 'CAPTURE|';
        return $this->stream(...);
    }
    private function stream($value) {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base86A', '|', static::class === 'Child86A', '|',
             $this === $weakMaker->get(), '|';
        try { Fiber::suspend('first86'); yield $value; return 87; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakMaker->get() !== null, '|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child86A extends Base86A {
    public function stream($value) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
function Run86A() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->current();
    echo 'VALUE|', $value === 86, '|';
    $g->next();
    echo 'RETURNED|';
}
$maker = new Child86A();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$callback = $maker->capture();
$weakCallback = WeakReference::create($callback);
$g = $callback(86);
unset($callback, $maker);
$fiber = new Fiber('Run86A');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'first86', '|', $weakMaker->get() !== null, '|', $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'RESUME|';
$fiber->resume();
echo 'DONE|', $g->getReturn() === 87, '|', $fiber->isTerminated(), '|',
     $weakMaker->get() !== null, '|', $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|';
unset($g, $fiber);
echo 'DROP|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|', $weakCallback->get() === null, '|E';

purpose: Independent fromCallable private BYREF generator is compatibly rebound to a Leaf receiver; original Closure/maker retire, final Closure and receiver stay through CLOSED, while SEND input and raw reference cache retain distinct owners through abort and Gen drop.

<?php
class Token86R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input86R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
class Base86R {
    public function capture() {
        echo 'CAPTURE|';
        return Closure::fromCallable([$this, 'stream']);
    }
    private function &stream(&$token) {
        global $weakNew, $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base86R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf86R', '|',
             $this === $weakNew->get(), '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('bound86');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token86R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input86R, '|',
                 $weakNew->get() instanceof Leaf86R, '|';
        }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child86R extends Base86R {
    public function stream(&$token) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
class Leaf86R extends Child86R {}
function Run86R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input86R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$maker = new Child86R();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($maker);
$original = $maker->capture();
$weakOriginal = WeakReference::create($original);
$new = new Leaf86R();
$weakNew = WeakReference::create($new);
echo 'REBIND|';
$callback = $original->bindTo($new);
$weakCallback = WeakReference::create($callback);
unset($original, $maker);
echo 'REBOUND|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakOriginal->get() === null, '|';
$token = new Token86R();
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = $callback($token);
unset($callback, $new, $token);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|', $weakNew->get() !== null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() instanceof Token86R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run86R');
$stop = new Exception('stop86');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'bound86', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $weakInput->get() instanceof Input86R, '|', $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|',
     $weakNew->get() instanceof Leaf86R, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakToken->get() instanceof Token86R, '|', $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|',
         $weakNew->get() instanceof Leaf86R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token86R, '|',
     $weakCallback->get() !== null, '|', $weakNew->get() instanceof Leaf86R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakCallback->get() === null, '|', $weakNew->get() === null, '|',
     $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
